name: @waste/server
description: The kit the two Node servers, the API and the worker, share: the environment's primitives each app's env.ts declares its variables with (`src/env.ts`, over zod) and the bind and graceful close (`src/listen.ts`, over Hono's Node adapter). Built on @waste/process, the dependency-free half the supervisor and @waste/db read, so neither carries zod or Hono for it. Server-only: apps/web is fenced out in eslint.config.mjs. Ships TypeScript source for tsx consumers.
